# computer-manager

> Single static Go binary that turns a Linux machine (GUI desktop, headless
> sandbox, container, cloud VM) into a remotely controllable computer over a
> token-authenticated HTTP API on :1337. This file is the **bootstrap
> entrypoint for an AI agent** that needs to install, run, or reason about
> the manager. The client/controller half of the pair is `computer-agent`
> (github.com/ab0t-com/computer-agent) — prefer driving machines through
> that CLI rather than raw HTTP.

## What this repo ships

- `release/computer-manager` — the manager binary (static linux-amd64, no deps).
- `release/desktop` — perception sidecar CLI (X11 + AT-SPI: catalog/query/
  await/watch/diff). Installed next to the manager; optional.
- `release/checksums.txt` + `release/VERSION` — verify everything you download.
- `install.sh` — POSIX, HTTPS-only, sha256-mandatory installer for both.
- `docs/USAGE.md` — env vars, endpoint groups, GUI prereqs, ops notes.
- `skills/computer-manager-host-setup/` — agent skill: install/run/secure/
  verify/troubleshoot the manager on a target machine; bundles both
  binaries in `assets/` for air-gapped installs.
- `skills/computer-manager-api/` — agent skill: drive the manager directly
  over HTTP — full endpoint catalog (system/terminal/files/RPA/awareness/
  window/workflows) + the complete `desktop` sidecar reference (8 modes,
  exit codes). A live manager also self-documents: GET /openapi.json,
  /llm.txt, /llm-cli.txt.

## Install (on the machine to be controlled)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ab0t-com/computer-manager/main/install.sh | sh
# pin:    REF=v0.1.0 curl -fsSL .../install.sh | sh
# no-sudo: PREFIX=$HOME/.local curl -fsSL .../install.sh | sh
# skip perception sidecar: SKIP_DESKTOP=1 curl -fsSL .../install.sh | sh
```

## Run

```sh
MANAGER_API_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 32) computer-manager   # binds 0.0.0.0:1337
DISPLAY=:1 MANAGER_API_TOKEN=... computer-manager            # + GUI/RPA verbs
computer-manager --version                                    # "manager <version>"
```

`MANAGER_API_TOKEN` is mandatory — no token, no boot. Every request must send
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Control surface (groups)

| Group | Endpoints (representative) | Headless? |
|---|---|---|
| system | /ping /health /manager/version | yes |
| terminal | /execute /sessions | yes |
| files | upload / download / list | yes |
| GUI/RPA | screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard, OCR, image-match | needs DISPLAY |
| perception | `desktop -mode catalog|query|await|watch|diff` (sidecar, via /execute) | needs DISPLAY |

## Key facts an agent should internalize

- **This binary executes commands and writes files by design.** Only install
  it on machines meant to be handed to a controller; firewall :1337 to the
  controller's network; TLS-proxy it across the open internet.
- **Headless is first-class.** terminal/files/system work with no X at all.
  GUI/RPA + the desktop sidecar need a display — real, or
  `Xvfb :1 -screen 0 1920x1080x24 &` then `DISPLAY=:1`.
- **GUI verbs shell out** to xdotool/scrot/xclip/tesseract — install those on
  the target for RPA work (the installer can: it warns when missing).
- **Drive it with computer-agent**, not curl: `computer-agent sandboxes add
  mybox http://<host>:1337 <token>` then `exec`, `screenshot`, `upload`,
  fleet fan-out, etc.
- **Perception goes through exec:** `computer-agent exec "desktop -mode
  catalog -json"` — observe/find/wait with the sidecar, act with the
  manager's RPA endpoints.
- **Update = re-run the installer.** Idempotent, sha-verified; prior binary
  kept at `computer-manager.previous` for one-step rollback. Same for the
  sidecar (`desktop.previous`).
- **Token rotation = restart** with a new MANAGER_API_TOKEN.
- One manager per machine; fleets are a client-side concept.
